about: The launch view across the harbour as the game draws it beyond its kit: the rocket (the game's kept model earth_launch_rocket, made again on the route with library surfaces), the harbour, the far ground, the rocket's floodlight, the moonlight and the night sky. Frame: EarthSite's own.

objects.name: rocket
objects.from: earth_site.gd:260-262 ROCKET_AT (-270, 0, -60) and ROCKET_HEIGHT, 1282-1285 _stand_the_rocket_up (turned PI / 2); launch_rocket.gd:14-15 TALL 60 m. The rocket is the game's kept model earth_launch_rocket (data/definitions/prop.json; Pixal3D take wf-launch-rocket-2) made again on the route: painted by its close-up's SAM regions with the judge's materials (hull_white_gloss, dark_panel, bare_steel; data/parts/wf-launch-rocket-2.npz) and baked from the library (make_chunky, 30k triangles), past the model gate; rebaked on 2026-10-10 with a solid wall of two voxels (0.4 m) instead of 5 mm, which had left the copy full of holes (its lumpy feet), kept in the world's release as models/launch_rocket_solid (the first bake stays as models/launch_rocket); its foot stands on the top of the stage's pad pieces (1.2 m up; the game's deck lies on the ground). Its baked box is 60.27 m tall from 6 mm under its foot, so it is scaled by 0.9955 to 60 m and stands 1.21 m up.

stars.from: game/world/sky/sky.gd:19-33,517-544 (SEED 9, STAR_COUNT 1800, SKY_DISTANCE 700: a SphereMesh of radius 0.7 with 4 sides and 2 rings, scaled 0.4 to 1.3, every direction), game/art/materials/star.tres (unshaded #eef2ff); hung here at 1900 m with each star as wide seen from the middle, past everything the stage holds and inside the views' 2000 m reach, as the game hangs them just inside its camera's reach; turned as the game turns them at the base minute in `turn`

turn.from: sky.gd:136-144,455-472 (_stars_turn: Space.frame_basis() transposed, the Moon's facing at the base minute, times the Earth night's stage_turn), space.gd:76-80, orbits.gd:128-145,345-356 (Orbits.facing_at, _moon_own_frame), earth_site.gd:44-54 (the block hangs off the Moon unturned, so the site's axes are the Moon's own); the minute measured on the game's shots by tools/usd/star_turn.py --axes site: the field found on 7 of them (launch balcony-rocket, balcony-shore, harbour-edge-rocket, shore-near; square balcony-left, balcony-podium, square-tower-near: 13 to 52 stars each), their turns each within 0.03 to 0.10 degrees of the facing at a minute from 59.75 to 60.75, and this the middle one (the clock held there; minute 0, where a new run opens, is 4.5 degrees off); the flat's and the street's own shots do not measure (the street's show 0 to 13 lone dots, the flat's balcony shot lays 8 stars at most at any field of view tried)

game_only: the far city across the harbour is the framework's own, in 3D (the far_city place, tools/usd/far_city_stage.py, seed 7): 2,188 made towers of five kinds rows deep along a far shore 1.3 to 1.8 km off, their windows lit, with code-built mountains behind and water out to the shore; the pencil tower, the low waterfront block and the housing slab are not made yet, so their lots carry the made kinds and the waterfront has no low blocks. The game hangs four photographs of Hong Kong there instead (earth_site.gd:327-335,959-972), which no stage carries

the night glow: at night the game blooms whatever is brighter than its glow threshold over the whole Earth site (night.gd:35-37,128-138, NIGHT_GLOW_THRESHOLD 0.85 while the eye is at the site; lighting.json bounce_tuned glow_intensity 0.8), the lit windows and the floodlit rocket here too; only the square's record carries it (environment glow), so this place's stage draws none
